_comment: How rows of MonsterDatabase-DelvingDeeper.csv collapse into one entry of the Monster Level Tables. Rows named 'N Hit Dice X' and 'N-Headed Hydra' are collapsed automatically by build.py (one entry per band with the sizes in that band), and dragons are placed by age from dragon-ehd.tsv. Each rule here is a regex on the Delving Deeper name (Table 3.1); 'family' is the entry label and 'member' the text listed in parentheses (backreferences allowed, empty for none). Rows that match the same family and fall in the same band become one entry.
